title: Chinese Ginseng Herbal Chicken Soup
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 free range chicken, cut into 4 to 8 pieces
1 Korean ginseng (or American ginseng), about 10 gram
10 dried red dates/jujube (Chinese: 红枣 - hong zao)
2 tablespoon dried goji berries (Chinese: 枸杞 - gou qi)
ldInstructionsRaw: Rinse and drain all the dried herbs to remove dust and dirt.
Place all ingredients in a soup pot and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.
Remove from heat and serve warm.
